title: Ernst Ludwig Ehrlich Studienwerk: Doctoral Scholarship
summary: ELES provides doctoral scholarships for talented Jewish doctoral candidates across all disciplines except medicine, and for non-Jewish PhD students researching Jewish subjects, to study in Germany.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines and concentrations except medicine.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised institution of higher education in Germany or, if the applicant holds German citizenship, in an EU member state or Switzerland (or in justified cases, extra-European).

nationality.notes: Not explicitly specified as all nationalities; requires selecting country from the provided list.

residence.notes: Country in which you are living and from which you are applying must be selected from the provided list.

mandatory.text: Technically qualified Jewish doctoral candidates in all disciplines and concentrations (except medicine) or non-Jewish PhD students proposing research projects focusing on Jewish subjects
Candidates are at the initial stage of their doctoral projects when applying for the scholarship funding
Admission to a doctoral programme at a state or state-recognised institution of higher education in Germany or, if the applicant holds German citizenship, in an EU member state or Switzerland
German language skills at level B2
Active involvement in, e.g., the Jewish community, the social field, youth work, student organisations or their social environment
Regular contact with the liaison lecturer and active participation in the scholarship's non-material services, activities and organisations

exceptions.text: In justified cases doctoral programmes at a higher education institution in an extra-European country may be funded

funding.description: Monthly stipend of 1,650 EUR and a flat-rate research allowance of 100 EUR, as well as contributions toward health insurance and, if applicable, family-friendly subsidies.
funding.duration: Generally awarded over a standard period of 3 years. In exceptional cases, renewal once for 6 months.

application_rounds.notes: Deadlines for scholarship application are 31 March for admission on 1 October of the same year. Extracted deadline was '03-31'; year not confirmed.
Deadlines for scholarship application are 30 September for admission to the programme starting 1 April of the following year. Extracted deadline was '09-30'; year not confirmed.

recurring_deadline_notes: Deadlines are 31 March and 30 September annually.

steps.text: Submit an application via the ELES application portal (desktop computer recommended).

sources.title: Ernst Ludwig Ehrlich Studienwerk: Doctoral Scholarship - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The scholarship funds doctoral candidates for research projects at higher education institutions in Germany.
